construction.document_triangle: An (en,fr,es) document triple with all en-fr, en-es and es-fr linkGrp edges.
construction.document_deduplication: For each English document, keep the lexicographically first all-edge (fr,es) pair.
construction.document_scope: Rank canonical en|fr|es triples by SHA-256 and structurally inspect the first 512 only.
construction.unit_graph: Within each selected document triple, create nodes (language,document,sentence-id); for every nonempty XCES link, join every node on both sides and retain the pair type.
construction.closed_unit: A connected component containing en, fr and es nodes and at least one link of each pair type en-fr, en-es and es-fr. Many-to-many IDs remain in the same component.
construction.unit_identity: SHA-256 of release, three document references and sorted per-language sentence-ID lists.
construction.reservation: Rank all closed units in the 512-document scope by unit identity hash and reserve the first 512 only if at least 512 exist.

rejections: components missing any of the three languages
components missing any of the three pair types
advance_rule: Advance OPUS GlobalVoices to structure-qualified confirmation candidate only if at least 512 unique closed units exist, with zero input hash mismatches and zero duplicate unit identities.
